model_interpretation.claim: Each ambient-occlusion hit uses the same ray origin for all 64 ambient rays, but the sphere intersection path recomputes each sphere-relative origin and its squared-distance term for every direction. items.subject: Ambient-ray generation and intersection throughput
items.objective: Investigate ambient-ray generation and intersection throughput in src/candidate.cpp while keeping this separate from primary-ray traversal and OpenMP scheduling. Contrast the cost of scalar direction generation (for example, paired sin/cos only if supported by the frozen build) with batched/compiler-vectorized or intrinsic sphere/plane intersections; measure isolated variants before combinations. Preserve the uniform independent sampling distribution, random consumption where possible, all 64 rays per hit, geometry, and hit/root conditions. Do not use early-outs that omit required intersection work or unverified ISA instructions; retain a build-valid fallback if needed and do not inspect the runtime environment. Report correctness and repeated timings for all official configurations, including nsubsamples=3.
